card.architecture: Step1X-Edit i1258 (StepFun) — DiT fp8 + Flux AE + Qwen2.5-VL-7B encoder, run via the raykindle ComfyUI node (int8 + offload; flash-attn patched to PyTorch SDPA). The original Step1X-Edit release (superseded by v1p2).
card.summary: StepFun's original instruction editor (i1258), fp8. 11 edit operations (add/remove, style, text). Runs at size_level 1024, 28 steps, CFG 6. Older/weaker than v1p2 but lightweight.
use_cases: instruction editing (add/remove/replace, style transfer, text edits)
lightweight edits when v1p2 is overkill
card.pick_when: You want the original Step1X-Edit; it's lighter than v1p2 but lower quality.

prompt.guidance: Provide an input image + imperative instruction.
prompt.example: Remove the watermark and brighten the photo
prompt.overview: Plain natural-language edit instructions; 11 supported operations.

speed.note: fp8 DiT + Qwen2.5-VL via the node's int8/offload; 28 steps.

ui_help.note: Edits an existing image from an instruction (original Step1X-Edit).

edit_use_cases: original Step1X-Edit instruction editing: add/remove/replace, style transfer, text editing
